title: A Field Guide to the Unquiet

modules.text:
Welcome, curious reader. This book is a field guide, not a dare. Begin with the [[Necronomicon|guide_necronomicon]], learn how [[Potential Energy|guide_pe]] behaves, then follow the trail to the first [[Gateway Key|guide_gateway]]. Gold words open their own entries when clicked.

The pages open as the Necronomicon grows through its tiers. A locked page means 'later', not 'you missed a secret'.
